facts.value: ASU offers more than 250 study abroad experiences in 65+ countries. Study abroad opportunities range from as short as a week to an entire year, and you receive course credit for whichever program you choose.

There are more than 800 student clubs and organizations at ASU. If you don’t find any clubs that interest you, you can start your own student club — all you need is two other students and a faculty or staff advisor.

ASU is home to more than 70 fraternities and sororities. Greek life has played an important role at ASU for more than 85 years, and members are dedicated to service, charity, leadership, student government, academics and university pride.
